prompt:
Assess ISO readiness for: Industry: Precast Concrete, Company Size: 230 employees, Pain Points: Compressive strength test failures 3% of batches, rebar placement errors on-site, no design review process for custom molds, crane operation near-misses, silica dust monitoring not performed

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- readinessScore (string): overall ISO readiness score
- gaps (string): identified gaps in current system
- recommendations (string): recommended actions to address gaps
- standards (string): applicable ISO standards

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response: ANSWER: {"readinessScore":"Moderate","gaps":"Quality control issues (compressive strength test failures, rebar placement errors), lack of design review process for custom molds, safety concerns (crane operation near-misses), inadequate environmental monitoring (silica dust).","recommendations":"Implement a robust quality management system (QMS) to address compressive strength test failures and rebar placement errors. Establish a formal design review process for custom molds. Enhance safety protocols and training for crane operations. Introduce regular monitoring and control measures for silica dust. Conduct employee training on ISO standards and requirements.","standards":"ISO 9001 (Quality Management), ISO 14001 (Environmental Management), ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety), ISO 19650 (Management of Information Over the Lifecycle of Construction Works)"}
